The request path with the cache:

```mermaid Token lookup with cache
sequenceDiagram
  participant C as Client
  participant M as Middleware
  participant K as Cache
  participant A as Auth service
  C->>M: Request + token
  M->>K: get(token)
  alt hit
    K-->>M: session
  else miss
    M->>A: verify(token)
    A-->>M: session
    M->>K: set(token, 5 min)
  end
  M-->>C: Response
```

And what logout does:

```mermaid Logout flow
flowchart LR
  A[Logout request] --> B{Token cached?}
  B -- yes --> C[Delete entry]
  B -- no --> D[Skip]
  C --> E[Revoke at auth service]
  D --> E
  E --> F[200 OK]
```
